verdict.rationale: The docs show an application-based onboarding flow: person, business and account applications (docs-4, docs-18). KYC/KYB runs through a bank-approved third-party vendor (docs-5, docs-19), which loosely hints at a split between program and bank responsibilities, and incremental KYC can run without opening an account (docs-6). Nothing shows an ops-facing queue, pending-status reasons, or a way to submit additional documents. Missing for 10: application status/pending-reason visibility, additional-document submission, an explicit program-vs-bank decision ownership model, an ops queue UI or workflow, and independent corroboration.
